[color=#f1c232] ﻿---[/color][size=2]A new town, a new farmhouse, and a new farm to settle into![/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Windows Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Windows]here on the wiki[/url]﻿ if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on Windows)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains 8 folders, one of which is "[CP] Durin's Rest") into your "SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"SteamLibrary \ steamapps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Mods \ Durin's Rest \ [CP] Durin's Rest"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]

[size=2][color=#f1c232][b]
[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]MacOS Install:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
1) [/b][/color]Download, install, or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download, install, or update [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]. (Look on YouTube or [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI_on_Mac]here on the wiki﻿[/url] if you can't figure out how to install SMAPI on MacOS)

[b][color=#f1c232]3)[/color][/b] Download, install, or update [u][b]all the other requirements[/b][/u] under the "Requirements" tab above.﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]5)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]Move the extracted folder (which contains 8 folders, one of which is "[CP] Durin's Rest") into your "Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this:
﻿"Library \ Application Support \ Steam \ SteamApps \ common \ Stardew Valley \ Contents \ MacOS \ Mods \ Durin's Rest \ [CP] Durin's Rest"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size]




[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[size=2][u][color=#f1c232][b][size=5]Game Compatibility:[/size][/b][/color][/u]
[/size][size=2] ﻿Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6 [/size][size=2]CONFIRMED. Probably works with earlier versions as well but I haven't tested it with anything less than 1.5.4.[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player.

Not fully compatible with Multi-Player. Some quests and events won't look right but you can absolutely play it on multiplayer and still have fun![/size][size=2]
[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=2]
- Compatible with all other expansion mods like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp

- Compatible with all other maps mods!

- If you want the Warp Scepter to be able to take you to Durin's Rest, make sure you have "AccessFromWand": true set in the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8567]WarpNetwork [/url]mod's config

- Does [b][u][color=#ff0000]NOT[/color][/u][/b] work with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Deluxe Journal[/url] because Deluxe Journal is incompatible with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11436]Quest Framework[/url].

- Does [b][u][color=#ff0000]NOT[/color][/u][/b] work with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8616]Personal Effects Redux[/url] for an as of yet unknown reason

- Does [b][u][color=#ff0000]NOT[/color][/u][/b] work with our [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12889]Dwarven Brewing[/url] as that mod is a standalone version of the brewing system in this mod[/size][size=2]
[/size][size=2]

Downloads.Description:
Download all requirements and then Place in Stardew Valley\Mods folder

Check the changelog for changes...

An expansion that adds in a dwarven town! Adds in 7 NPCs, 7 monsters, 6 fish, 8 crops, 71 recipes, 3 weapons, new quests, a new mine & a new farm!
